newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits steady, Deng death ignored.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits steady, Deng death ignored.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady on Thursday in lacklustre trade with news of the death of Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping largely ignored by the market, dealers said.

"The death of China's leader Deng Xiaoping had little impact on the market. Some people are waiting for tonight's weekly jobless claims and housing starts figures for more clues to market direction," he said.
Most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims and January housing starts data.
